title: Job Details

fields.label: Vacancy status
fields.name: job_status
fields.instructions: Closed vacancies remain editable and may keep their public detail page, but they are removed from the open positions list and cannot accept applications.

fields.label: Job reference
fields.name: job_reference
fields.instructions: Optional internal or public reference, for example SEES-ENG-001.

fields.label: Location
fields.name: job_location
fields.instructions: Leave empty when the role is remote or the location has not been approved for publication.

fields.label: Closing date
fields.name: closing_date
fields.instructions: Optional. The vacancy automatically stops appearing in the open positions list after this date.

fields.label: Accept applications
fields.name: applications_enabled
fields.instructions: Enable only after an authorised recipient, privacy wording, retention policy and a safe Contact Form 7 form have been confirmed.
fields.message: Show the application form for this open vacancy

fields.label: Contact Form 7 shortcode
fields.name: application_form_shortcode
fields.instructions: Use a complete shortcode such as [contact-form-7 id="123" title="Job application"]. Configure file type/size limits, spam protection, privacy consent and the authorised recipient inside Contact Form 7.

description: Operational fields for an individual vacancy.
